patch_description: The current single 12+1 circular seed with coordinate descent gets stuck at 0.72 of benchmark. Following the recommendation, I introduce multiple diverse seeds — 3-fold and 4-fold rotationally-expanded configurations, a slightly perturbed 13-gon, and a triangular-lattice-like arrangement — then refine each with a faster gradient-guided ascent (using finite differences on the soft-min objective) plus a final hill-climb pass, returning the best by true score. The min-triangle-area inner loop is also vectorized better via precomputed pairwise structure. Multiple seeds break the structural trap of one fixed symmetry while keeping determinism (no RNG) and manageable runtime.
